note: Per-adult (lower-carb) portions in grams of raw ingredients. Kids: about 0.6x protein, full grain. Values for POC only.

dishes.name: Samai idli
dishes.baby: Unsalted mini idli from the baby bowl, mashed into plain dal
steps: Soak 3 parts millet and 1 part urad separately 4-6 h
Grind urad fluffy, then millet; mix; set baby bowl aside before salt
Ferment 8-12 h; steam 10-12 min

dishes.name: Samai dosa
dishes.baby: Soft unsalted dosa strips
steps: Use the 2nd-day millet batter at room temperature; thin with a little water
Spread thin on a hot tawa, ½ tsp oil around the edge, cook one side until crisp

dishes.name: Samai vegetable uthappam
dishes.baby: Soft unsalted uthappam pieces without onion
steps: Use the 3rd-day (slightly sour) batter; pour a thick 1 cm round
Top with grated carrot, onion and coriander, cover and cook both sides on medium

dishes.name: Kambu idli
dishes.baby: Unsalted mini idli from the baby bowl, mashed into plain dal
steps: Soak 3 parts millet and 1 part urad separately 4-6 h
Grind urad fluffy, then millet; mix; set baby bowl aside before salt
Ferment 8-12 h; steam 10-12 min

steps: Use the 2nd-day millet batter at room temperature; thin with a little water
Spread thin on a hot tawa, ½ tsp oil around the edge, cook one side until crisp

dishes.name: Kambu vegetable uthappam
dishes.baby: Soft unsalted uthappam pieces without onion
steps: Use the 3rd-day (slightly sour) batter; pour a thick 1 cm round
Top with grated carrot, onion and coriander, cover and cook both sides on medium

Ferment 8-12 h; steam 10-12 min

Ferment 8-12 h; steam 10-12 min

steps: Use the 3rd-day (slightly sour) batter; pour a thick 1 cm round

dishes.name: Thinai adai
dishes.baby: Too coarse; give sprouted ragi porridge instead
steps: Soak thinai, toor, chana and urad 4 h
Grind coarse with chilli and ginger; no fermentation
Cook thick on tawa with ½ tsp oil

dishes.name: Adai kuzhi paniyaram
dishes.baby: Give mini idli with curd instead
steps: Use the adai batter; stir in grated carrot and curry leaves
Cook in a greased paniyaram pan, turning once, until golden on both sides

dishes.name: Pesarattu
dishes.baby: Soft unsalted pesarattu pieces made before adding onion and chilli
steps: Soak whole moong and 2 tbsp rice overnight
Grind with ginger, chilli, cumin; no fermentation
Spread thin, top with onion

dishes.name: Instant ragi dosa
dishes.baby: Soft unsalted ragi dosa
steps: Whisk ragi flour, rice flour, curd, salt and chopped onion into a thin batter; rest 15 min
Pour from the edge inwards on a hot tawa like rava dosa; cook until crisp

dishes.name: Multigrain seed toast
dishes.baby: Crust-off toast fingers (seeds ground into the loaf)
steps: Loaf (16 slices): 325 g atta, 50 g oats, 50 g ragi, 25 g jowar, 50 g roasted-gram flour, 15 g each ground flax and sesame, 25 g ground pumpkin seed, 7 g yeast, 6 g salt, 30 ml oil, about 330 ml warm water
Knead 10 min, rise 1 h, shape into a 9x5 inch tin, rise 45 min, bake 35 min at 200 °C; cool fully before slicing
Toast 1 slice per adult; freeze slices for the week

dishes.name: Vegetable sambar
dishes.baby: Plain toor dal and soft vegetables lifted before tamarind and tempering
steps: Cook toor dal with turmeric, 4-5 whistles
Simmer vegetables in tamarind water with sambar powder 10 min
Add dal and salt, boil 5 min, temper

dishes.name: Peanut chutney
steps: Dry-roast peanuts, peel; grind with coconut, a small piece of tamarind, 1 dry chilli and salt
Temper with mustard and curry leaves

dishes.name: Roasted-gram chutney
steps: Grind roasted gram, coconut, a small piece of ginger, 1 green chilli and salt with water
Temper with mustard and curry leaves

dishes.name: Onion-tomato chutney
steps: Saute onion, tomato and urad dal in oil until soft; cool
Grind with a dry chilli and salt; temper

dishes.name: 2 boiled eggs
dishes.baby: Hard-boiled yolk and white, mashed
steps: Boil 10 min, cool in water, peel; sprinkle pepper and salt

dishes.name: Egg podimas (2 eggs)
dishes.baby: Well-cooked scrambled egg, no salt
steps: Saute onion, green chilli and curry leaves in 1 tsp oil
Add beaten eggs with turmeric and salt; scramble until just set; finish with pepper and coriander

dishes.name: Vegetable omelette (2 eggs)
dishes.baby: Well-cooked plain egg strips
steps: Beat eggs with chopped onion, tomato, spinach and salt
Cook in a non-stick pan with a few drops of oil, fold and serve

dishes.name: Tawa paneer cubes (50 g)
dishes.baby: Crumbled soft paneer
steps: Cut paneer into fingers, rub with turmeric, pepper and salt
Sear on a hot tawa with ½ tsp oil, 1 minute a side

dishes.name: 1 cup curd
dishes.baby: Plain curd
steps: 1 cup home-set curd

dishes.name: Red rice (mappillai samba) (1 small katori)
dishes.baby: Soft overcooked rice, mashed

dishes.name: Brown rice (1 small katori)
dishes.baby: Soft overcooked rice, mashed

dishes.name: Ponni rice (1 small katori)
dishes.baby: Soft overcooked rice, mashed

dishes.name: Samai rice (1 small katori)
dishes.baby: Soft overcooked rice, mashed

dishes.name: Chicken kuzhambu
dishes.baby: Chicken boiled separately with turmeric, shredded fine
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, turmeric and salt for 20 min; set aside the baby's pieces to boil plain
Saute onion, tomato, ginger-garlic in oil; add chicken, 2 tbsp kuzhambu powder and ground coconut-poppy paste; cook 20 min
Set aside 1 piece per adult before adding the gravy, for the dinner pepper fry

dishes.name: Mutton kuzhambu
dishes.baby: Mutton pressure-cooked plain, shredded very fine
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Pressure-cook mutton with turmeric, salt and ginger-garlic, 6-7 whistles; lift the baby's portion now
Make the onion-tomato masala with kuzhambu powder and coconut paste, add the mutton and stock, simmer 15 min
Set aside the dinner pepper-fry portion before adding the gravy

dishes.name: Ayala (mackerel) kuzhambu
dishes.baby: One piece steamed with turmeric, every bone removed
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Boil tamarind water with sauteed shallots, tomato, garlic and 2 tbsp fish-curry powder for 10 min
Slide in the mackerel pieces, simmer 6-8 min without stirring. Steam the baby's piece separately and debone

dishes.name: Pomfret tawa fry
dishes.baby: Piece steamed before frying, flaked, bones removed
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Marinate pomfret in chilli powder, turmeric, lemon and salt 20 min (steam the baby's piece before marinating)
Shallow-fry on a tawa with 1 tsp oil, 4 minutes a side

dishes.name: Mathi (sardine) kuzhambu
dishes.baby: Plain dal rice mash instead
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Clean sardines; boil tamarind gravy with shallots, garlic and fish-curry powder
Add sardines, simmer 8 min. Adults only (small bones)

dishes.name: Prawn thokku
dishes.baby: Plain dal rice mash instead
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Saute onion and tomato in oil until thick; add chilli, coriander powder and pepper
Add cleaned prawns and cook 5-6 min until curled. Adults and older children only

dishes.name: Egg kuzhambu (2 eggs)
dishes.baby: Hard-boiled egg mashed, lifted before gravy
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Boil eggs, peel and slit
Simmer in onion-tomato-tamarind gravy with kuzhambu powder and coconut paste for 8 min

dishes.name: Paneer-peas kurma
dishes.baby: Crumbled paneer and mashed peas before masala
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Blend onion, tomato, cashew-free coconut and fennel into a paste
Cook the paste with peas 8 min, add paneer cubes and garam masala, simmer 3 min

dishes.name: Soya chunk kuzhambu
dishes.baby: Plain moong dal rice instead
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water 10 min and squeeze
Simmer with peas in onion-tomato gravy and kuzhambu powder for 10 min

dishes.name: Rajma kuzhambu
dishes.baby: Rajma lifted before spices, mashed smooth (must be fully cooked)
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Pressure-cook the soaked pulse until very soft (rajma 6-8 whistles; karamani or kollu 4-5)
Saute onion and tomato in 1 tsp oil with ginger-garlic, add 1 tbsp kuzhambu powder and tamarind water, boil 5 min
Add the cooked pulse, simmer 10 min. Keep 1 katori of plain cooked pulse aside for the evening sundal

dishes.name: Kadala curry
dishes.baby: Chana mashed smooth, skins removed
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Pressure-cook soaked black chana 6 whistles
Simmer with roasted-coconut-coriander paste, onion and tomato for 10 min; temper with curry leaves

dishes.name: Karamani kuzhambu
dishes.baby: Karamani mashed smooth before spices
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Pressure-cook the soaked pulse until very soft (rajma 6-8 whistles; karamani or kollu 4-5)
Saute onion and tomato in 1 tsp oil with ginger-garlic, add 1 tbsp kuzhambu powder and tamarind water, boil 5 min
Add the cooked pulse, simmer 10 min. Keep 1 katori of plain cooked pulse aside for the evening sundal

dishes.name: Kollu (horse gram) kuzhambu
dishes.baby: A little kollu mashed smooth before spices
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Pressure-cook the soaked pulse until very soft (rajma 6-8 whistles; karamani or kollu 4-5)
Saute onion and tomato in 1 tsp oil with ginger-garlic, add 1 tbsp kuzhambu powder and tamarind water, boil 5 min
Add the cooked pulse, simmer 10 min. Keep 1 katori of plain cooked pulse aside for the evening sundal

dishes.name: Keerai paruppu (spinach dal)
dishes.baby: Dal and greens before tempering, mashed with rice
dishes.kid: Half the adult protein, lifted before extra chilli
steps: Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric, garlic and tomato
Cook chopped spinach 3 min in the dal; mash. Lift the baby's portion, then add salt and a cumin-garlic tempering

dishes.name: Beans-carrot poriyal (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Wash and chop the vegetable small; temper 1 tsp oil with mustard, urad dal and curry leaves
Add the vegetable with a pinch of turmeric and salt, sprinkle water, cover and cook on low until just soft
Finish with 1 tbsp grated coconut. Lift the baby's and child's portion before any chilli

dishes.name: Cabbage-peas poriyal (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Wash and chop the vegetable small; temper 1 tsp oil with mustard, urad dal and curry leaves
Add the vegetable with a pinch of turmeric and salt, sprinkle water, cover and cook on low until just soft
Finish with 1 tbsp grated coconut. Lift the baby's and child's portion before any chilli

dishes.name: Beetroot-beans poriyal (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Wash and chop the vegetable small; temper 1 tsp oil with mustard, urad dal and curry leaves
Add the vegetable with a pinch of turmeric and salt, sprinkle water, cover and cook on low until just soft
Finish with 1 tbsp grated coconut. Lift the baby's and child's portion before any chilli

dishes.name: Vendakkai poriyal (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Dry the okra fully, slice into rounds
Saute in oil on high, uncovered, 10-12 min with turmeric and salt; finish with coconut

dishes.name: Cauliflower poriyal (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Wash and chop the vegetable small; temper 1 tsp oil with mustard, urad dal and curry leaves
Add the vegetable with a pinch of turmeric and salt, sprinkle water, cover and cook on low until just soft
Finish with 1 tbsp grated coconut. Lift the baby's and child's portion before any chilli

dishes.name: Keerai poriyal (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Any greens: spinach, arai keerai, siru keerai, mulai keerai or murungai keerai
Temper mustard, urad and onion; add chopped greens and salt; cook uncovered 4-5 min; finish with coconut

dishes.name: Pudalangai kootu (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Any watery vegetable: snake gourd, bottle gourd, chow-chow or ash gourd
Cook the vegetable with moong dal and turmeric; add ground coconut-cumin-green chilli; simmer 3 min; temper

dishes.name: Avial (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Cut mixed vegetables (drumstick, carrot, beans, raw banana, yam) into fingers; cook with turmeric and salt
Stir in ground coconut-cumin-chilli and beaten curd off the heat; finish with coconut oil and curry leaves

dishes.name: Beans paruppu usili (double portion)
dishes.baby: Same vegetable steamed separately in the morning cooker, mashed
steps: Soak toor and chana dal 1 h, grind coarse with chilli, steam 10 min, crumble
Toss with steamed chopped beans in a mustard tempering for 5 min

dishes.name: Curd (1 katori)
dishes.baby: Plain curd
steps: Home-set curd from toned milk, set the night before

dishes.name: Tomato rasam
steps: Boil tamarind water with tomato, rasam powder, garlic and a spoon of dal water
Remove at first froth; temper with ghee, mustard and cumin

dishes.name: Cucumber-carrot-onion salad
dishes.baby: Steamed vegetable fingers instead of raw salad
steps: Cucumber, carrot, onion and tomato with lemon, pepper and a pinch of salt

dishes.name: Black chana sundal (1 katori)
dishes.baby: Whole legumes and nuts are a choking risk; give mashed fruit with curd
steps: Use pulse cooked soft (soak overnight, pressure-cook 4-5 whistles)
Temper mustard, curry leaves and a dry chilli in 1 tsp oil; toss in the pulse with salt and grated coconut

dishes.name: Karamani sundal (1 katori)
dishes.baby: Whole legumes and nuts are a choking risk; give mashed fruit with curd
steps: Use pulse cooked soft (soak overnight, pressure-cook 4-5 whistles)
Temper mustard, curry leaves and a dry chilli in 1 tsp oil; toss in the pulse with salt and grated coconut

dishes.name: Kollu sundal (1 katori)
dishes.baby: Whole legumes and nuts are a choking risk; give mashed fruit with curd
steps: Use pulse cooked soft (soak overnight, pressure-cook 4-5 whistles)
Temper mustard, curry leaves and a dry chilli in 1 tsp oil; toss in the pulse with salt and grated coconut

dishes.name: Sprouted moong salad (1 katori)
dishes.baby: Whole legumes and nuts are a choking risk; give mashed fruit with curd
steps: Soak green moong 8 h, drain, tie in a cloth 12-24 h to sprout
Toss with cucumber, carrot, onion, lemon and pepper; steam 3 min for children

dishes.name: Roasted chana and peanuts (1 katori)
dishes.baby: Whole legumes and nuts are a choking risk; give mashed fruit with curd
steps: Mix roasted gram and roasted peanuts; a pinch of chilli powder for adults

dishes.name: Boiled groundnuts (1 katori)
dishes.baby: Whole legumes and nuts are a choking risk; give mashed fruit with curd
steps: Pressure-cook raw groundnuts in their shells with salt, 3 whistles

dishes.name: 1 chapathi (only if hungry)
dishes.baby: Soft chapathi pieces soaked in dal
steps: Atta dough with water and a pinch of salt; rest 20 min
Roll thin; cook on a hot tawa, brush ½ tsp oil

dishes.name: Pepper chicken dry (from lunch)
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Saute onion and curry leaves in 1 tsp oil; add the reserved lunch chicken
Add 1 tsp crushed pepper and ½ tsp fennel powder; dry-roast 8 min until coated

dishes.name: Mutton pepper fry (from lunch)
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Fry onion and curry leaves; add the reserved cooked mutton
Add crushed pepper, fennel and a little garam masala; roast dry 10 min

dishes.name: Paneer-capsicum bhurji (80 g)
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Saute onion, capsicum and tomato in 1 tsp oil with turmeric and cumin
Crumble paneer in, cook 3 min; finish with pepper and coriander

dishes.name: Egg bhurji with vegetables (2 eggs)
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Saute mixed vegetables 5 min
Add beaten eggs, scramble with salt and pepper

dishes.name: Moong dal tadka (1½ katori)
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Pressure-cook moong dal with turmeric and tomato
Temper ghee or oil with cumin, garlic, onion and red chilli; pour over

dishes.name: Chana masala (1½ katori)
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Pressure-cook soaked white chana 6 whistles
Simmer in onion-tomato masala with chana masala powder for 10 min

dishes.name: Soya-mushroom pepper fry
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Soak and squeeze soya chunks; slice mushrooms
Stir-fry with onion and capsicum on high with garlic, pepper and salt

dishes.name: Thinai pongal, dal-heavy (1 katori)
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Cook thinai and moong dal SEPARATELY in two cooker containers (1:3 water), with vegetables in the dal
Temper ghee with pepper, cumin, ginger and curry leaves; adults take 1 small katori thinai + 2 katori dal-veg

dishes.name: Moong-besan chilla with paneer (2)
dishes.baby: Lifted before chilli and salt, mashed; or sprouted ragi porridge with ghee
steps: Grind soaked moong dal with ginger and chilli; stir in besan and grated vegetables
Cook like a dosa; fill with crumbled paneer

dishes.name: Soya chunk sundal (½ katori)
dishes.baby: Not for babies; give mashed fruit instead
steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water 10 min, squeeze dry, chop
Temper mustard, curry leaves and onion; add soya, salt, pepper and grated coconut
